lawful_coverage_claim: complete only for the exact authority-declared finite candidate grammar evaluated exhaustively
candidate_evaluation_geometry: F exact candidate evaluations; T=sum_f T_exact(f); if coordinate subsets through K are enumerated then subset count H_K=sum_{k=1..K} choose(I,k) before value/target expansion
discoverable_without_extra_proof: all candidates inside declared grammar including interactions/reversals/minority configurations if grammar contains them
minority_support: supported minorities remain reachable unless authority support floor lawfully excludes them
pruning_semantics: only authority-declared semantic impossibility/support/risk-set pruning may remove candidate before exact evaluation; pruning changes F but must be replayable
replay_evidence_required: frontier version/hash; every candidate identity or deterministic enumerator; support/risk-set law; exact evaluation/validation result; exclusions
completeness_invalidity_condition: claim fails if any in-frontier candidate is skipped heuristically or current algorithm's limited search geometry is mislabeled exhaustive

lawful_coverage_claim: path-local coverage only unless separate theorem proves global coverage for declared objective/class
candidate_evaluation_geometry: approximately sum over visited nodes/steps of candidate evaluations available at that state; often far below F but data/order dependent
discoverable_without_extra_proof: strong locally visible forks; not guaranteed global interactions outside chosen path
minority_support: minority reachable only if greedy objective/support/path exposes it
pruning_semantics: discarded candidates are heuristic exclusions unless authority explicitly defines greedy path as the coverage class
replay_evidence_required: exact greedy algorithm/version/tie law; candidate set at each step; winning path; pruned alternatives sufficient to replay claimed path coverage
completeness_invalidity_condition: cannot claim discovery of all lawful interactions, XOR, minority or reversals merely because greedy search was cheaper

lawful_coverage_claim: coverage limited to candidates retained by explicit beam/adaptive policy unless a proof gives stronger recall/completeness
candidate_evaluation_geometry: sum over stages of evaluated frontier expansions; bounded roughly by beam_width*depth*candidate_expansion plus scoring/revalidation, but exact geometry policy-dependent
discoverable_without_extra_proof: broader alternatives than greedy but still not universal by default
minority_support: minorities survive only if scoring/support rules keep their path
pruning_semantics: beam truncation/adaptive stopping is heuristic unless governed coverage theorem says otherwise
replay_evidence_required: algorithm/version; beam width/adaptive rule; candidate score inputs; all retained/discarded states needed for deterministic replay of claimed coverage
completeness_invalidity_condition: claim fails if discarded path could contain an in-scope relation and no safe-pruning theorem exists

lawful_coverage_claim: exact coverage only over screen-passing set unless screen has an authority-approved no-false-negative guarantee for the claimed relation class
candidate_evaluation_geometry: T_screen(F)+sum_{f in F_pass} T_exact(f); potential large saving when F_pass<<F but guarantee depends on screen
discoverable_without_extra_proof: relations preserved by screen guarantee or explicitly reduced coverage class
minority_support: minority may be lost by prevalence/signal screen unless support law and recall guarantee preserve it
pruning_semantics: screen is a pruning theorem only if its false-negative boundary is governed/proven; otherwise it changes semantic coverage
replay_evidence_required: screen definition/version; all screen inputs/results; pass/fail reason; exact replay for survivors; coverage theorem/negative authority
completeness_invalidity_condition: unary-salience screening invalidates exhaustive XOR/zero-signal interaction claim; top-k screening invalidates minority-complete claim

lawful_coverage_claim: complete only within the recursively reachable state-space defined by branch-generation and per-node candidate coverage
candidate_evaluation_geometry: sum_{b in B_visited}[T_membership(b)+sum_{f in F_b} T_eval(f on R_b)]; B and R_b data/support dependent
minority_support: minorities reachable when branch creation/support policy preserves them
pruning_semantics: branch pruning/support/depth/candidate-removal laws define reachable space; heuristic early stop limits coverage
replay_evidence_required: branch predicate/member replay; ancestry; algorithm/version; per-node candidate frontier; stop/prune reasons; deterministic ties
completeness_invalidity_condition: cannot claim general interaction discovery if a zero-signal root prevents entry to a branch where relation exists

lawful_coverage_claim: complete for exact governed response-pair candidate set P under fixed universe/risk-set semantics
candidate_evaluation_geometry: sum_{p in P} T_pair(p); naive candidate count at most choose(Q,2) unordered or Q(Q-1) ordered when direction is semantically required, but authority may define smaller P
discoverable_without_extra_proof: all pairwise cotravel candidates in P
minority_support: minority pair cells preserved only if full contingency retained
pruning_semantics: pair eligibility can bound P; processing-order omission is not lawful when pair belongs to selected coverage
replay_evidence_required: pair frontier identity; risk sets; respondent overlap; pair contingency; directionality authority; algorithm/version
completeness_invalidity_condition: pairwise completeness cannot be promoted to k-way configuration completeness

lawful_coverage_claim: complete only through declared maximum arity J_max and target candidate family
candidate_evaluation_geometry: candidate tuple count H=sum_{j=2..J_max} choose(Q,j) before question eligibility restrictions; each exact tuple costs target binding plus occupied-cell accumulation
discoverable_without_extra_proof: all in-scope higher-order response configurations through J_max
minority_support: supported nonmodal cells retained by exact contingency
pruning_semantics: arity/eligibility/support laws may bound H; lower-order signal cannot safely prune parity class without proof
replay_evidence_required: target frontier; arity bound; each evaluated tuple or deterministic enumerator; exact result/typed empty; pruning proof
completeness_invalidity_condition: claim fails beyond J_max or if lower-order screen removes in-scope parity candidates

lawful_coverage_claim: lawful only when authority declares candidate infeasible/out-of-scope below exact support/risk-set condition; output must preserve typed underpowered/zero-support state where semantically required
candidate_evaluation_geometry: can reduce F and per-candidate R_b before expensive evaluation; exact saving data-dependent
discoverable_without_extra_proof: does not itself reduce coverage if pruning rule is part of declared authority and state is recorded
minority_support: low-support supported facts may remain queryable even if excluded from discovery significance; must not be rewritten as absent
pruning_semantics: semantic pruning uses governed feasibility/support law; heuristic convenience pruning does not get this status
replay_evidence_required: support/risk-set authority; exact counts/member set or replay basis; prune state/reason
completeness_invalidity_condition: using a cost-driven threshold not authorized by discovery law silently narrows terminal minority frontier
